result.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWzkxrGSCPyPwhsviH4Qz8TL3RkX8DN1jy7rLjWWvn8QQ/image.png)


Today will mark opening day of the [Blockchain Rio](https://blockchainrio.com.br/) conference, held at the Expo Mag Convention Center in beautiful Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Our team of community members @arlettemsalase, @jonsnow1983, @starkerz, @edmundochauran and @disregardfiat are there on site representing Hive. 

This is a one-of-a-kind conference which boasts 300+ speakers and a unique Leaders special event. It's a great networking and outreach opportunity for Hive and we are thrilled to be a part of it.

Arlette will deliver a keynote presentation, **"Introducción al Protocolo Hive, ¿por qué Hive y qué soluciona?"** | *Introduction to the Hive protocol, why Hive and what does it solve?* on the 25th. She and Starkerz will speak on two panels during the conference, times TBD.

The event schedule can be found at: https://app.blockchainrio.com.br/agenda 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtDXEZi2bMwJMtGRHdMs1aDA3XfHJ1cU1CL61cjErAHH/image.png)
<sup>A great networking evening.</sup>

If you're in the area and want to drop by, let us know here!
